text:
Subject: Broken heater in Apartment 4B, repair needed within 48 hours

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in Apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called you on October 3 to report it and haven't heard back, so I'm writing again in case the message didn't reach you.

The heater is still broken. Overnight temperatures are in the 40s, and the apartment is getting cold.

Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat, which is why I'm asking for a repair within 48 hours of this email. Please let me know when someone can come by.

Thank you,
Apartment 4B
